requests.email_text: Hi team, could we book a 45-minute kickoff on March 10 or March 11, 2026? I can meet from 09:00 AM to 11:30 AM, but please avoid March 10 from 10:00 AM to 10:15 AM. Keep this on the design track.

Hello, I need a 90-minute budget review on April 2, 2026. My open window is 01:00 PM to 04:30 PM. Please do not place it during 02:15 PM to 02:45 PM because I have another call. Mark this as finance-priority.
Good afternoon, I am free for a 30-minute check-in on May 5, May 6, or May 8, 2026. Morning only: 08:30 AM to 10:00 AM. No meetings on May 6 before 09:00 AM. Remote preferred.
